I will spread cow manure that I have saved, and I will also buy one small bag of fertilizer to give the crop a boost because the soil here is tired. I will spray herbicide once when the weeds start coming up, since I cannot afford to let the family spend all their time weeding such a small plot when there are other fields to tend. My wife and children can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting on this quarter-acre piece, so I will not hire any extra hands, and I will not irrigate because millet does well with the rains we get in this season.
